_label: FICTIONAL demo client (Brewline Demo Roasters). Every name, handle and fact is invented.
note: Source of truth for timing, layout, texts and sound events. Studio builds production/data/timeline.json from it (harness step 5). Static camera: coordinates are screen pixels at 1080×1920, y down. Values are starting points for the first still; studio may adjust them without changing the meaning of a frame or a cause (card.md §8) and logs every change in production/log.md.

draft.rule: same detail: sizes, cut-edge noise and shadows scale by W/1080

canvas.seed_note: mulberry32 for grain, cut edges and bean paths; Math.random, Date and performance.now are forbidden

safe.rule: every text box (titles, scene labels, end card) inside text_box on every frame where it is visible; x ≤ 940 keeps text clear of the Reels buttons

palette.copper_rule: copper only on the lit band and the keyword of each title

door.how: flip on the vertical axis (scaleX 1 → −1), inner side espresso

roaster.rule: generic pictogram: no brand, no model features (card.md §1)

scoop.parked: leaning on the right side of the bin from frame 0

band.rule: lit if and only if 5 < needle_day <= 28

knob.rule: knob_deg = 12 * needle_day on every frame; it turns only when the needle moves

needle_rule: monotone cubic (PCHIP) through all keys, so equal neighbouring keys hold still and nothing overshoots except the explicit −0.3 key; the five hops in B3 last 0.12 s each; one detent click on every integer day crossed

beats.action: needle sweeps 31 → 0; band flashes copper while the needle is inside it
beats.frame_0: whole set: shelf with roaster (still), tray (empty), bin (lid down), bag (open), lever up; radio with needle at day 31 moving left; band unlit; title area empty (T1 from 0.10)

beats.action: drum spins up, door opens, beans pour into the tray, stir arm turns
beats.cause: beans leave only through the open door and follow the chute

events.what: drum front disc spins up 0 → 0.8 rev/s
40 beans along the chute into the tray; the tray fill grows
stir arm turns; drum slows down to a stop at 4.4; door closes at 4.4

beats.action: beans go into the bin; then only the needle hops 1 → 5
beats.cause: the tray tips toward the lifted lid; one knob click per hop

events.what: tray tips 16°, 25 beans slide into the bin, tray returns

beats.action: scoop fills the bag twice, bag top folds, stamp prints the label
beats.cause: the scoop carries beans from the bin; the imprint appears on the frame the pad touches the label

events.what: scoop trip 1: dip in the bin, arc to the bag, 12 beans pour in at 8.8–9.0
scoop trip 2: pour at 9.4–9.55; scoop returns to its parking place
top 40 px of the bag folds over
lever swings down; pad lands on the label
impact: pad squashes 4 % for 2 frames, bag dips 3 px, imprint 'ROAST DATE' + 3 bars appears

beats.action: needle glides 5 → 28 through the band, then back to 14
beats.cause: the knob turns; the band is copper only while the needle is inside it

beats.action: props slide out, the bag comes to the centre with its stamped label; hold
beats.cause: one object left: the bag with its date

events.what: roaster, tray, bin slide out left (stagger 0.08 s); lever slides out right
bag to x 540, scale 1.35, standing on the shelf

texts_exact.text: When is your coffee at its best?
Then every bag gets its roast date
Best brewed about 5 to 28 days after roast
Check the roast date on yours

reading_rule: each title is on screen for at least 0.6 s + 0.25 s per word, and never less than 1.5 s

demo_mark.note: under the handle, inside the title band

logo_layer.reason: brand/assets/logo.svg is not part of the demo

tone.rule: plays on the same frames as band_lit (±1)

cover.title: Day 5 to 28
cover.note: a label, not a claim; built by code

fallback: If the paper-cut reads as 'vector icons with drop shadows' after 3 tries on the stills, ask the owner via the orchestrator: keep it flat (no cut-edge noise, one shadow depth) or stop.
